name: Hotel Riva Sorgente

booking.direct_advantage: Booking on our own site includes breakfast for two and a late check-out at 13:00, subject to availability.

room_types.name: Junior Suite
room_types.beds: one queen plus a single sofa bed
room_types.notes: Full balcony. The sofa bed suits a child or one adult.

room_types.name: Famiglia
room_types.beds: one queen plus two singles in a connected second room
room_types.notes: The two rooms connect through an internal door and are only sold together.

facts.check_in: From 15:00. Reception is staffed 07:00–22:00; later arrivals must be arranged in advance.
facts.breakfast: Buffet, 07:30–10:00, included in all direct bookings.
facts.parking: 14 private spaces, €18 per night, must be reserved in advance as there are fewer spaces than rooms.
facts.pets: One dog up to 10kg is welcome, €20 per stay. Not permitted in the breakfast room.
facts.children: Children of all ages welcome. Under 3 stay free in a cot.
facts.extra_beds: €45 per night, only in the Junior Suite.
facts.accessibility: One ground-floor room with a step-free bathroom. The building is 19th century and the lift does not reach the third floor.
facts.pool: No pool. Private lake access and a swimming platform, 150m from the hotel.
facts.restaurant: Breakfast only. Six restaurants within a five-minute walk.
facts.smoking: Non-smoking throughout; smoking permitted on the terrace.
facts.payment_methods: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, bank transfer, cash up to the legal limit.
facts.city_tax: €2.50 per person per night for guests over 12, paid at the hotel, not included in the room rate.
facts.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. Inside 7 days, one night is charged.
facts.deposit: One night taken at booking as a deposit.
facts.nearest_station: Varenna-Esino, then the ferry to Menaggio, about 20 minutes.
facts.transfers: A private transfer from Malpensa can be arranged, €180 each way, booked at least 48 hours ahead.

faq.q: Is the hotel on the lake itself?
faq.a: The hotel is 150m from the shore, with its own private lake access and swimming platform.
Yes. The Menaggio ferry landing is a seven-minute walk.
Yes, but it does not reach the third floor.
